summary: Iteration 21 — simplified report lifecycle (handover scrapped) fully verified. All 12 tests in test_report_handover.py PASS (token dedupe, legacy aliases→completed, handover 404, PDF upload+round-trip, PDF non-PDF 415, PDF empty 400, /reports listing, pending-count=0, billing/pending-reports=[], appointment+invoice atomic). Added a new focused suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_report_extras.py (8 tests) covering the scenarios missing from the main suite: PDF re-upload GridFS replacement, PDF fallback template when no blob exists, cross-tenant 403 on upload/fetch, cross-tenant /reports listing isolation, patient history shape+cross-tenant, legacy billing WhatsApp delivery. 8/8 PASS. Also re-ran test_m01_frontdesk.py + test_m01b_appointments.py + test_m01c_billing.py as regression (64/64 PASS) to confirm the tokens.py dedupe change did not break existing front-desk / billing flows. Total: 20/20 relevant tests pass + 64/64 regression tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/report_handover.py:124-191 upload_report_pdf: correct GridFS idempotent re-upload (deletes old_id before uploading new), correct 400/413/415 status codes, correct tenant scoping via _get_session_tenant_scoped, correctly sets report_status='completed' + test_completed_at on first upload. Good.

routers/reports.py:77-90 _stream_pdf: correctly prefers uploaded GridFS blob over template generator; falls back cleanly to generate_report_pdf if no upload present — verified with test_pdf_fallback_template_when_no_upload.

routers/tokens.py dedupe: correctly returns existing active token with upgraded service when same patient books again same day; after status=completed a new token is created — verified with test_token_dedupe_skipped_once_completed. No race seen in quick-succession POSTs (sequential happy path).
Cross-tenant isolation is tight: Delhi admin gets 403/404 on Mumbai session PDF upload + fetch, and never sees Mumbai session in GET /api/reports?status=completed.
Legacy endpoints /mark-printed, /complete-test, /generate-report all land on report_status='completed' with no intermediate 'report_ready' state — verified.
POST /api/sessions/{id}/handover correctly returns 404 now — feature truly removed.

Minor suggestion (non-blocking): backend/routers/report_handover.py should eventually drop the deprecated /reports/pending-count stub and /billing/pending-reports stub once the frontend no longer polls them; they currently return hard-coded {pending:0} and [] respectively, which is fine for back-compat but wasted round-trips.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The simplified draft→completed report lifecycle is fully verified. For any future changes in this area: (1) test_report_handover.py covers the core 12 scenarios from the review request, (2) test_iter21_report_extras.py covers the 8 edge cases (GridFS idempotency, template fallback, Delhi↔Mumbai cross-tenant 403, patient history shape, legacy WhatsApp billing delivery). Together they run in ~9s and exercise real HTTP through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend capture (html2canvas + jsPDF in /app/frontend/src/components/reports/captureAndUpload.js) is explicitly out-of-scope per the review request and will be manually verified by the main agent.
rca of the issue: NO bugs found in this iteration — the three user-reported issues (1) patient Jasmita appearing twice in front-desk queue, (2) saved PDF was server-template instead of the printed rich PDF, (3) handover feature — are all correctly fixed by the current code. Verified by: (1) test_token_dedupe_same_patient_same_day confirms 2 POSTs → 1 token with upgraded service, exactly 1 row in GET /tokens; (2) test_pdf_reupload_replaces_previous_blob + test_upload_pdf_and_retrieve confirm the exact PDF bytes uploaded via multipart are the exact bytes served by GET /reports/{id}/pdf — the rich client-rendered DOM capture will thus be preserved forever; (3) test_handover_endpoint_is_gone confirms /sessions/{id}/handover now returns 404, and both legacy aliases /mark-printed + /complete-test correctly land on report_status='completed' with no intermediate 'report_ready' state.
